name: joke-agent
description: Cantonese / Traditional-Chinese joke fetching agent. Discovers, extracts, deduplicates, classifies, and stores jokes from LIHKG, HKGolden and Baby Kingdom. Default LLM: google/gemma-4-31b-it via nvidia-ollama-bridge; codex/gpt-5.5 available as fallback. Human-in-the-loop test mode for review-before-save.
